test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence. 

__Its__ time we left to the airport.
solution:
The correct answer is **"It's"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Let's see the sentence formation:

__
 
• ***It's ***time we left to the airport. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here we will learn the difference between the two words:

 
• So what is the difference between *its and it’s?** Its (without an apostrophe)*** is a possessive pronoun, like his or her, for nouns that don’t have a defined gender. In contrast, ***It’s (with an apostrophe) ***is the shortened form, or contraction, of it is or it has.
